description: WSO2 SAP S/4HANA Reservation Document (A2X) provides a way to interact with the [Reservation Document (A2X) API](https://api.sap.com/api/CE_APIRESERVATIONDOCUMENT_0001/overview). The service allows to create, update and delete reservation documents for materials, assign them to cost centers, sales orders or assets, and handle transfer postings between plants.
key-features: Create reservation documents through the OData V4 Reservation Document (A2X) API
Assign reservations to cost centers, sales orders or assets
Read, update and delete reservation documents and their items
